status: FROZEN before either variant was trained. The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the commit that froze it and in every screening report.
title: Screening round 2: does any dose of the tail term help without collapsing the ensemble?
note: Selection on the validation period only. A variant that passes is a candidate, not a result: the thesis claim needs a full-length run and a separate frozen test on data no choice here has seen, in practice the winter 2026-27 data.

candidates.tailA2000: finetune_tail_a at step 2000: tail arm threshold (20 mm per 6 h), weight 1 371.6, a tenth of the tail arm's
candidates.tailB2000: finetune_tail_b at step 2000: threshold 5 mm per 6 h, the 97.3rd percentile of 6-hour Nordic precipitation in the training window (20 mm per 6 h is the 99.94th), weight a tenth of the measured equal-on-extremes weight, so the term is the same share of an extreme state's loss as in variant A

reference.tail2000: the original tail arm at step 2000, the known failure, scored alongside so the gate is seen to catch it

threshold_note: By rarity, 5 mm per 6 h on the grid (97.3rd percentile) and 20 mm per day at the gauges (96.4th) are close, so variant B trains at the rarity the ranking metric scores; no separate matched-threshold metric is needed.
training_matched: Every model at step 2000 of the same 3 000-step learning-rate schedule, same data, seed and ensemble size.

gate_spread.measure: spread-skill ratio difference, candidate minus control2000, lead 30 h
gate_spread.fails_if: the point estimate is below -0.05 (half the collapse seen at step 2000) or the upper 95% bound is below 0
gate_spread.why: The tail arm lost the primary endpoint through an overconfident ensemble. A variant that repeats it is out, whatever its scores.

ranking_metric.measure: fair twCRPS at 20 mm per day, candidate minus control2000, lead 30 h
ranking_metric.passes_if: the point estimate is at or below 0
ranking_metric.why: Screening selects, it does not prove; 61 days cannot resolve the effect sizes of the main evaluation, so no interval is demanded here. The interval is reported.

guard_ordinary_weather.measure: fair CRPS over all cases, candidate minus control2000, lead 30 h
guard_ordinary_weather.fails_if: the candidate is more than 1 percent worse

decision.pass: passes the spread gate, the ranking metric and the guard
decision.winner: the passing candidate with the lowest twCRPS at 20 mm; ties within 0.002 go to the lower weight
decision.if_none_pass: No full-length run. Report the dose-response (original, A, B) as the finding, and move to a spread-preserving change of the loss rather than more weights and thresholds.

reported_not_decisive: fair twCRPS at 50 mm per day
occurrence ratio O_t and share of exceedances no member reached, at 10, 20 and 50 mm (scripts/tail_calibration.py)
